hero.title: Menu
hero.intro: Wings by the pound in 60 flavours, plus wraps, quesadillas, loaded fries, appetizers and bundles.

pricesNote: All prices are in Canadian dollars and do not include tax. Tax is added to your bill.
spiceNote: Spicy level runs from 1 to 6, with 6 the hottest.
footnote: Allergy disclaimer: we cannot guarantee that any menu item is completely free from cross-contamination.
